pr_title: Handle ordering in plain highlighter for multiple inputs
pr_body:
The ordering logic in the plain highlighter only worked for single-valued
inputs.  If you had multiple inputs, then order-by-score would only do this
ordering for fragments within each input, and order-by-position would 
interleave fragments from the different inputs.  This commit fixes both
issues.

Fixes #87210
pr_comments: Hi @romseygeek, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Plain Highlighter “order”:”score” is not working for fields with multiple values
comments: Thanks for reporting this with such a clear reproduction @gmarouli.  It turns out that our ordering logic within the plain highlighter does not handle fields with multiple values correctly.  I've opened #87414 to fix it.
Oops, sorry, I meant to thank @ahoogol for the report and reproduction! (Although thanks @gmarouli for triaging it :))

review_comments: Just out of curiosity, did you consider making the list sorted from the start or would this have major drawbacks? I didn't clearly check whether sorting is always done here, maybe not and thats the reason why we don't need a sorted list from the start...
The highlighter outputs fragments sorted by score, so if we only have a single input and we want score order then there's no need to do anything.  Otherwise we need to re-sort
Also just curious about the switch from Lucene CollectionUtil to plain list sort here, any pros / cons about the former?

Just that it means we get to use built-in collections; it's possible that lucene's introSort is slightly more efficient, but we're talking tiny lists and small sets of results so I thought clarity was more important.
